_doc: WIKIREF-1022: English Wikipedia as a DISCOVERY PORTAL ONLY (owner 2026-10-22: "ignore wikipedia for information, it is usable only as a portal to search for urls to sources"). Read only by vera/wiki_ref_portal.py. The module extracts scholarly identifiers (DOI, PMCID, PMID, arXiv) cited by the matching articles and emits acquisition candidates; Wikipedia text is never evidence, never stored, never logged, never in a candidate. OFF unless `enabled` is exactly true. Not wired in until an integrator applies work/wikiref-1022/INTEGRATION.md. No key, no secret, no env read.
_calibration_note: max_articles, max_refs, timeout_s and the budget are planner priors, not decision thresholds: every decision gate (resolve, licence, injection, relevance, admission) is the unchanged acquisition gate the candidates go through. Live shape check 2026-10-22 (work/wikiref-1022/INTEGRATION.md, section Observed shapes): field names only; not a latency calibration. Calibrate from 'autoacq wikiref' log lines.
user_agent: VERA-DAR-wiki-ref-portal/0.1 (non-commercial educational research assistant; identifier discovery only; https://github.com/taggm-ghc/vera-dar)

budget._note: per question: ONE generator=search request returns the matching articles' wikitext (prop=revisions); continuation requests (the API splits large results) are allowed while the budget lasts. No retry: a failed request ends the portal for that question (the other providers stand). Bodies over max_response_bytes are refused before parsing.

rank._note: the sentence before each <ref> is compared to the question (stem overlap) IN MEMORY to order the identifiers, then discarded. Citations outside a sentence (bibliography lists) score 0 and keep article order.
